Drew Reinland is the creator of the Golforia series, combining imaginative storytelling with golf to inspire young readers and junior golfers.

title: Golforia Hole 2: Honest Hills Manor | Children's Book
body_html:
Golf has rules. Golforia has… different rules.

Welcome back to Golforia, the illustrated golf world created, written, and drawn by Drew Reinland, where every hole is an adventure, and there’s always something waiting around the next dogleg.

In Hole #2 — Honest Hills Manor, kids follow the game while learning some of the things that make golf, golf: honesty, etiquette, patience, problem-solving, taking care of the course, and figuring out what to do when your shot doesn’t exactly go according to plan.

Because that’s golf.

You make a decision. You take the shot. Sometimes it works. Sometimes it absolutely does not. Then you pick up your club and keep going.

Along the way, young readers are introduced to the language, traditions and rhythm of the game without ever feeling like somebody handed them a golf textbook. The lessons are tucked inside Drew’s wild illustrations, humor and storytelling.

And while Golforia was created with young golfers in mind, we wouldn’t exactly call it just a kids’ book. It’s for golf families, muni kids, grown-up golf nuts, art people, and anyone who remembers what it felt like when the game was still completely new.

Read it. Gift it. Leave it on the coffee table. Collect the series.

title: Slick and Deuce Golf Headcovers
body_html:
Greenside Run:

They call ’em Slick and Deuce.

No one knows where they came from, but every morning—before the first tee time, before the range picker starts his rounds—you’ll catch them on the putting green. Two scrappy birds, posted up like regulars, putting with swag and talking more smack than your weekend foursome.

Some say they showed up one summer and never left. Others swear they’ve been around longer than the rust on the ball washers. Either way, if you see ‘em, you know what’s up.

Slick’s the smooth one—clean lines, low strokes, never misses inside five feet. Deuce? He’s got that street game: wild stances, bold reads, and a putter that looks like it’s seen too many parking lots.

They don’t play by tour rules. They play by muni rules—roll-ins count, sneakers over spikes, and no one’s keeping score unless it’s bragging rights. They’re out here every day, representing the real ones who learned the game on patchy greens and cracked concrete, not manicured fairways.

This headcover is their story.

A tribute to the early crews, the loud games, the love of the grind. It’s not country club clean—but it’s 100% muni.

Perfect for kids ages 4 and up, this golf storybook makes a great gift for junior golfers, golf families, and anyone who wants to inspire a love of the game.

Welcome to Golforia, a magical world where golf teaches more than just the game. When evil forces threaten everything they know, Milk, Max, and Chris discover that courage, friendship, and proper golf etiquette can change the future—not just on the course, but in life.

About the Author: 

Drew Reinland is the creator of the Golforia series, combining imaginative storytelling with golf to inspire young readers and junior golfers.

Our own Drew Reinland is a talented author and illustrator. With book 1 of this imaginative golf series, he is releasing his second book in children’s literature. Drew previously wrote and illustrated a popular comic book, known for his vibrant and playful artistic style, gaining a loyal following for his unique storytelling and expressive illustrations. This is his second book as an illustrator and his first as a published author, bringing to life a story that combines his love for humor, adventure, and heartwarming messages.

title: The Perfect Swing Acrylic Painting With Golf Clubs By Drew Reinland
body_html:
Drew Reinland: Innovating Golf Art with a Unique Approach

Drew Reinland is an artist whose innovative techniques and passion for golf have set him apart in the art world. One of his acclaimed works is a painting depicting Tiger Woods swing. This symbol is etched in golf history as one of the most iconic golf swing.

What truly sets this painting apart is Reinland's unconventional method. Instead of using traditional paintbrushes, Reinland employed his personal golf clubs—both irons and his driver—to create the masterpiece. This unique approach not only highlights his artistic creativity but also his deep connection to the sport of golf. Each stroke and detail of the painting is infused with the essence of the game, as Reinland skillfully maneuvered his clubs to achieve the desired effects.

Reinland's technique showcases his ability to merge his two passions: art and golf. By using the tools of the sport to create art, he adds a layer of authenticity and originality to his work that resonates deeply with golf enthusiasts and golf art lovers alike. This innovative approach not only pays homage to Tiger Woods grace, but also revolutionizes how golf art is perceived and created.

Drew Reinland's golf painting of Tiger Woods is more than just a visual representation; it's a testament to the artist's ingenuity and dedication. Through his unique use of golf clubs as painting tools, Reinland has crafted a piece that stands as a symbol of both artistic and athletic excellence, capturing a timeless moment in golf history with an unparalleled level of originality and creativity.

Acrylic painting

24 x 36 inch canvas

title: Tiger and The Green Jacket Poster Print
body_html:
Lemme just start with the jewel tones. I've said it before, I'll say it again and I literally want this on my so if I die and you stumble upon my grave and it doesn't read "an unsatisfiable taste for jewel tones" do the right thing and help me out...Contact someone and get that dialed for me. Back on track though this taste for jewel tones with me was definitely influence by the art in Aladdin and was soon after solidified by the art of Mary Grand Pre for the original American editions of Harry Potter. I mean the imagination of a child reading 'bout all this wizards kinda runs wild but the art by Grand Pre really nailed it for me, the way the colors blended and all the images were shaped and too this day I never get sick of that work. Great art, magical words, let's talk about a real living wizard. Tiger Woods. This dudes got 14 wands on him at all times casting syrupy potronus' in the shapes of draws, cuts, and major championship trophies & jackets. This fool don't play either he out her Avada Kedavraing muhfuckers on the 72nd green in epic fashion and he just got' show up next week and do it again. I spent my whole life taking that in every week. Shit really did seem like magic. Like this dude definitely got Dumbledor's number at the top of his contacts and I got a hunch that tEI3 insert that helped him get those first majors was actually just the sorcerers stone nicely inlayed. That said it only made sense to gel the two together into this piece.

title: Juicy Golf Bag Strap Cover
body_html:
We haven’t been this excited to introduce a new product in a long time! Digging back into the archives of our childhood memories, we kept talking about these old furry golf bag strap covers that you would throw onto your single strap Sunday bags back in the 80’s and 90’s and would give your bag a little more flavor with the functionality of added comfort and support on your shoulder. We haven’t seen a lot of these over the past 20 years so drawing inspiration from our nostalgia, we created an upgraded modern day version of our very own. Just slide your current bag strap through the middle and then connect the swivel hook to the same loop the top of your strap connects to and it will hold the golf bag strap in place and keep it from sliding on you.

- SWIVEL HOOK

- 25 INCH LENGTH

- MADE TO ORDER
